title: Green peas, frozen, cooked, fat added

content.title: About
content.content: Green peas are young pea pods harvested before full maturity. In this product the peas are blanched, frozen, and a small amount of vegetable fat is added to enhance flavor and texture. They are ready to eat after reheating and retain most of their nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Frozen cooked peas are a common ingredient in ready‑made meals and soups because they heat up quickly.
Adding a modest amount of fat improves the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins such as vitamin K and vitamin E.
Peas are one of the oldest cultivated crops, grown by humans for over 7,000 years.
Rapid freezing after cooking preserves the bright green color of the peas.
As a legume, peas can fix nitrogen in the soil, contributing to soil fertility.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Green peas provide about 5 g of protein per 100 g, making them a good protein source for vegetarians.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestive health and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Source of vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains folate
items.content: Folate is needed for DNA synthesis and is especially important during periods of rapid growth.

items.title: Helps regulate blood sugar
items.content: The low glycemic index of peas helps stabilize glucose levels after meals.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to peas.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared products may contain added salt; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Added fats
items.content: The fat added is typically vegetable (e.g., sunflower oil) and may not be suitable for certain dietary restrictions.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the frozen peas in the microwave or on the stovetop, seasoning as desired. They can be served as a side dish, added to salads, pastas, stews, or used as a filling for pies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen peas at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, consume within 2–3 days and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
